tests.name: Idle established session at the default ten-second export cadence

promql_expr_test.expr: (sum ((increase(pi_turn_count_total{user_email=~"test@example.com",axon_workflow_name=~".*",pi_repo_slug=~"test/repo"}[1h]) and (pi_turn_count_total{user_email=~"test@example.com",axon_workflow_name=~".*",pi_repo_slug=~"test/repo"} offset 1h)) or (max_over_time(pi_turn_count_total{user_email=~"test@example.com",axon_workflow_name=~".*",pi_repo_slug=~"test/repo"}[1h]) unless (pi_turn_count_total{user_email=~"test@example.com",axon_workflow_name=~".*",pi_repo_slug=~"test/repo"} offset 1h)))) and on() ((day_of_week(vector(time() + 43200)) == 1) or on() (label_replace(vector(1), "trend", "1h", "", "") unless on(trend) label_replace(vector(1), "trend", "1w", "", "")))
